title: Quadratic matrix character encoding
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every vector $w\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the function on $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$ obtained by decoding the homogeneous quadratic proof encoding of $w$ is the matrix character given by pairing with the rank-one matrix whose $(i,j)$ entry is $w_iw_j$.
